subject.title: fix(agents): terminate agent run on critical loop detection instead of continuing indefinitely

question: After real runtime proof is supplied, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106423 be retained as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106231?
rationale: Both branches implement nearly the same session-sensitive termination contract, and neither currently has the positive real-runtime proof needed to distinguish a safe landing candidate.

options.title: Require proof, then choose
options.body: Keep both candidates open only until one supplies convincing live terminal-behavior evidence, then retain the cleaner proven branch and close the duplicate.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Choose a candidate from source and automated tests without observing the resulting provider-turn and transcript behavior in a real OpenClaw run.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then choose
recommendation.body: Keep both candidates open only until one supplies convincing live terminal-behavior evidence, then retain the cleaner proven branch and close the duplicate.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the recent agent-core runtime integration and are the strongest available owner for selecting the canonical loop-termination contract.
